seoTitle: Video Rotator and Flipper: Fix Sideways Videos Online
metaDescription: Rotate a video 90, 180 or 270 degrees or mirror it, in your browser. Fixes phone clips recorded in the wrong orientation. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Rotates a video by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and optionally mirrors it horizontally or vertically.
why:
Phone videos sometimes carry an orientation flag that other software ignores, so they play sideways. Re-encoding the pixels the right way up fixes it for every player.

Nothing is uploaded. The file is decoded by your browser and re-encoded, so quality drops a little and the result is WebM (or MP4 where your browser can record it). It records in real time, so a 60 second clip takes about a minute and the tab must stay visible. A 90 degree turn swaps width and height.
howTo: Pick the rotation and tick flip options if needed.

faq.q: Why does my phone video play sideways elsewhere?
faq.a: It stores rotation as metadata that some players and sites ignore. Rotating the pixels removes the dependence.

faq.q: Is the mirror image text readable?
faq.a: Mirroring flips text. Use it only when you want that.
Almost. The video is re-encoded once.
